subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy (`streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`) while keeping `channels.feishu.streaming` protected from agent-side `config.patch`, or should maintainers choose a different Feishu-specific recovery surface?
rationale: The source-level issue is clear, but the durable fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested preview config while preserving current boolean/default behavior and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only soften progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and reduce scary exec failure copy, which is smaller but still leaves no supported way to stream answers while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit `channels.feishu.streaming` through `config.patch`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested preview config while preserving current boolean/default behavior and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Feishu metadata names this handle as the community maintainer for the plugin whose config policy would change.
